content.text:
Two wakings at 19 months is common, usually driven by a sleep-association habit - Remy needs you to get back to sleep, so the fix is helping him link sleep cycles on his own. Pick one settling method (slow parental withdrawal works well at this age) and use it consistently at bedtime first, then at each waking, for about a week.

Want the full night-by-night plan for Remy? Reply YES and I'll send it.
